Israel Vows to Remain in Southern Lebanon Amidst Hezbollah Threat

Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu visited southern Lebanon and stated that Israeli forces will not withdraw as long as the Hezbollah threat persists. This declaration comes amidst a fragile ceasefire and ongoing concerns about the long-term implications for Lebanon, where daily hardships and uncertainty remain despite the respite from active conflict.
